input.summary: Registered all 39 printed rows of J-1503010-09 Custodial Inventory (conformed through Amendment 0002) across three sites: NSA Tarpon Sound – Main Base (31 rows, 26 serviced), Saltmarsh Point Annex (5 rows, 4 serviced) and NOSC Cypress Landing (3 rows, 2 serviced). 32 facilities are in Recurring Work (726,250 SF gross / 380,975 custodial SF); 7 rows are out of scope: 175 option (under construction, Note 12), 190 and 192 NAF not in contract (Note 11), 240 and 245 Recurring Work deleted by Amendment 0002, SP-10 on-call only (Note 10), NOSC 3 unoccupied storage, no service (Note 9). Registered 10 grounds rows from J-1503050-04 (502.50 acres). Site info recorded; no previous/incumbent contract information in the package.
unresolved: Bldg 162 Outdoor Pool Bathhouse is seasonal (Memorial Day through Labor Day, inclusive, M–Su); the number of service days is not stated, estimated at 99 days/year.

Bldg 140 Gulf Breeze Galley: custodial scope only (dining room, entries, restrooms); kitchen, serving line and scullery are under Annex 13 (food service), which is not in this package; no dining headcount given.

J-1503050-04 FENCE LINE Semi-Improved (12.18 ac) and NAVY Unimproved (236.90 ac) are combined NSA TS/SPA acreage; the split between Main Base and Saltmarsh Point Annex is not given, registered without a campus.
Restroom counts per building are printed (Rest-rooms column) but fixture counts (WC/UR/LAV) are not; fixtures left null and restroom counts recorded in notes.
Contract period (base + options), growing season and incumbent contract data are not in this extract (Attachments J-1503010-07 Maps and -08 Floor Plans are provided upon award).
